items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze (calf) officially active vs. Panthers after expected-to-play reports.
items.why: Calf injury; expected and confirmed active
items.implication: Full WR corps available for CHI; reverse any Odunze-out beneficiaries

items.text: Malik Nabers (knee) situation murky for SNF; sounds up to him. Giants elevated Braxton Berrios and Dalen Cambre. Main slate news locked; only major proj change possible is Nabers.
items.why: Recovering from prior ACL/meniscus; full practice but non-committal, 'up to him'/'let God tell me'
items.implication: If out, targets to Fields/Mooney/Berrios; Likely upside noted elsewhere
items.opportunity: High residual target share if plays limited; monitor inactive window

items.text: Weekend reports summary: Love (ankle) and Odunze (calf) expected to play; Kamara (knee) not expected; Josh Williams activated (Sean Tucker doubtful); Nabers (knee) no news yet.
items.implication: Main slate largely locked per Levitan follow-up; Kamara out boosts Etienne proj
items.opportunity: Etienne volume spike; Love/Odunze usable if confirmed

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (MCL sprain/knee) is not expected to play vs. Lions and was later confirmed inactive; full participant late in week but not quite ready. Saints elevated CJ Donaldson.
items.why: MCL sprain; team cautious despite full Friday practice
items.implication: Etienne locked into lead role; Miller/Donaldson as depth

items.text: Patriots WR A.J. Brown will not need surgery on high ankle sprain but sidelined 4-6 weeks; officially placed on IR.
items.implication: Long-term absence; NE WR depth elevated

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers OUT after meniscus trim Tuesday; realistic chance miss only one game and return Week 2 at Chargers. Team will monitor feel this week.
items.implication: Michael Mayer expanded role Week 1; Bowers stash for W2

items.text: Cooper Rush will start at QB for Falcons; undrafted Jack Strand backup; Olamide Zaccheaus emergency QB and also emergency third RB (only two RBs active: Bijan and Brian Robinson). Tua and Penix inactive context.
items.implication: Potential negative for ATL passing game efficiency; Bijan still featured
items.opportunity: Bijan workload secure; monitor Zaccheaus gadget

items.text: Kamara's status (not expected/out) affects projections of guys like Travis Etienne.
items.implication: Elevated Etienne carries/targets/snaps vs DET (up-tempo game)
items.opportunity: Lead back role expansion, red-zone potential

items.text: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle sprain, Q) is expected to play vs. Chargers.
items.implication: Rookie workload available in ARI backfield

items.text: Isaiah Likely ranks high in fantasy PPG per target; Nabers won't be 100% Week 1 and Giants WR2 is Fields or Mooney—gimme all the Likely.
items.implication: TE upside if Nabers limited/out; target share opportunity
items.opportunity: Increased targets in two-TE or Nabers-down scenarios

items.text: Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr. officially inactive (back injury + contract/trade murk).
items.implication: Secondary impact for ATL pass game (London etc.)
items.opportunity: Slight WR upgrade vs PIT secondary

items.text: Chuba Hubbard is a viable flex this week; 'keeping it open' on The Chubbler.
items.implication: Startable in flex spots; monitor CAR RB committee

items.text: Week 1 snaps & pace: NO @ DET up in pace; MIA @ LV slow-paced slogs. Full report available.
items.implication: Higher play volume NO-DET favors skill players (Etienne, Lions backs/WRs); lower MIA-LV caps ceiling

items.text: Saquon Barkley vs Washington: averages 136.5 rush yds and 6.0 YPC in 4 games (incl playoffs) since joining PHI, with 21+ PPR in all; WAS front seven still projects below average.
items.why: Historical dominance vs WAS + defensive projection
items.implication: Strong RB1 start with rushing/TD upside
items.opportunity: High carry/red-zone share in favorable matchup

items.text: Chris Olave averaged 29% target share and 14.7+ PPR in 75% of games with Tyler Shough last year; Lions safeties on IR; high O/U game. Shough waiver available widely.
items.why: Chemistry with Shough + defensive holes + game script
items.implication: WR2/flex upside in potentially high-scoring NO-DET

items.text: Parker Washington averaged 24% target share on 70%+ routes last year; 16.4 PPG at 15%+ share. Browns CB Ward primarily on Brian Thomas Jr.
items.implication: Sleeper WR upside in JAC offense
items.opportunity: Route participation and targets vs CLE

items.text: When Marvin Harrison Jr. played 50%+ snaps, Michael Wilson averaged 5.5 PPG and 13% targets; off field Wilson 28% share. MHJ expected to play.
items.why: Target cannibalization data when MHJ active
items.implication: Fade Wilson if MHJ full go; MHJ maintains WR role

items.text: Justin Herbert fantasy PPG per pass attempt 52% higher with Joe Alt on field last year; Alt healthy. Cardinals weak pressure (27th) and PFF DL/secondary low ranks.
items.why: OL health boost + soft ARI pass rush/secondary
items.implication: QB1 upside with protection and matchup
